{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for internal test orders
internal_test_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f'Number of internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {internal_test_count}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders only, and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_numeric'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}')"}
